profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary: I started programming at 11 years old due to my passions in gaming but quickly realized the broad world that I was now a part of. The ability to create, and in doing so, help others achieve their dreams, improve their lives, or just post funny cat videos to their friends has fueled my ambitions and creativity since. I enjoy finding the right technology for the job and applying it in creative ways to solve problems. From drag and drop e-mail composers built in React, to lightning fast video encoding and streaming, to cloud orchestration and Golang tooling, my passions run deep into the coding world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working to improve the Netflix streaming experience in the living room and beyond.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Began by working on the scalability of the system, creating new architecture to support our transition to micro-services, overhauling important parts of the systems as needed, finding and researching new technologies for the team such as React and Docker, and creating patent pending technology for our video systems to help us stand out from our competitors. I have since transitioned to leading a team of developers to help them build their passions and create legacies of their own.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked primarily with the United States Olympic Committee on their Sitecore CMS implementation and integrating it with various platforms as well as assisting with production cloud deployments and performance improvements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked to implement a new e-commerce platform, redesign and overhaul event websites and backing CMS implementations and improve the event and training notification system.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on an EMR helping to improve the questionnaire builder and reporting system as well as various improvements to the EMR database and UI itself.
